title: A 13.5-mW 185-Msample/s Modulator for UMTS/GSM Dual-Standard IF Reception
function_summary: 13.5-mW 185-Msample/s Modulator: A system-oriented approach for the design of a TABLE I WCDMA/GSM STANDARD OVERVIEW UMTS/GSM dual-standard modulator is presented to demonstrate the feasibility of achieving intermediate frequency (IF) around 100 MHz, high dynamic range, and low power consumption at the same time.
